tasks.title: Fix BUG-26: done --technical misses a manifest path that contains a space

outcome.technical: In audit-task.py _technical_is_manifest the whitespace test is removed from the first guard; only empty and '-' return False first, then the manifest-equality and existing .json checks run (an existing .json path is never prose; the whitespace test was dead after them since the fall-through is False anyway). Docstring updated. New case pd15b in test_audit_task.py builds its fixture via mk(os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='s p '), 'dn-technical')), checks the manifest-path --technical is refused with REFUSED on stderr naming --technical, file bytes unchanged, and the positional spelling still closes writing the text. Results: test_audit_task.py --selftest exit 0, 1100/1100 cases (1099/1100 before the fix, only pd15b red); tools/sweep-selftests.py --spaced --quiet plugins/audit/tests/test_audit_task.py exit 0, 1/1 files ok, 1100 cases.
outcome.descriptive: done --technical now refuses the manifest path even when the path contains a space.
